source: Please wait for me at the arrivals gate, not outside.
target: Await my arrival at the arrivals gate, if you would. Do not stand waiting outside.

source: We got lost because the map was out of date.
target: We strayed from our path, led astray by a map whose time had passed.

source: I have a fever, so I won't come to work today.
target: A fever has seized hold of me. Today, I shall not come to work.

source: Please take your tablets after breakfast, not before.
target: Your tablets must follow breakfast, if you would, and never precede it.

source: The doctor says I should walk for thirty minutes every day.
target: The doctor has given counsel: I should walk for thirty minutes every single day.

source: Is the clinic open on Saturday mornings?
target: On Saturday mornings, does the clinic open its doors to those who seek it?

source: I haven't slept well since the operation.
target: Since the operation, restful sleep has refused to come to me.

source: If her temperature goes above 102, take her to the hospital.
target: Should her temperature climb beyond one hundred and two, bring her to the hospital.

source: Meera hurt her ankle while running yesterday, but it isn't swollen.
target: Meera injured her ankle while running yesterday… yet no swelling has risen to claim it.

source: Don't lift anything heavy for at least two weeks.
target: For two weeks at the very least, you must lift no heavy burden.

source: I'm trying to drink less coffee, but it's hard.
target: I strive to drink less coffee, but the struggle is a hard one.

source: My dentist appointment is at 3:45 on Tuesday.
target: My appointment with the dentist awaits me on Tuesday, at three forty-five.

source: Thank you for driving me to the hospital last night.
target: You drove me to the hospital in the depths of last night. For that, you have my gratitude.

source: Daniel is allergic to peanuts, so check the labels.
target: Daniel is allergic to peanuts. Examine every label with care.

source: The blood test results will be ready in two days.
target: Two days must pass before the blood test results reveal themselves.

source: Could you call the pharmacy to see if my prescription is ready?
target: Will you call the pharmacy and learn whether my prescription awaits me?

source: Sofia has had a cough for over a week.
target: For more than a week, a cough has held Sofia in its grip.

source: You shouldn't exercise until the injury heals.
target: Until the injury has healed, you should forgo all exercise.

source: I take one tablet in the morning and one at night.
target: One tablet I take as the morning rises… and one more as night descends.

source: The physiotherapist said the knee is healing well, but I shouldn't run yet.
target: The physiotherapist says the knee mends well, yet running must still wait for me.

source: Sorry, I can't come to the gym today; my back hurts.
target: Forgive me, I cannot come to the gym today. My back is burdened with pain.

source: We should get the kids vaccinated before school starts.
target: Before school opens its doors, we should see that the children are vaccinated.

source: Aisha doesn't eat sugar anymore, even on weekends.
target: Aisha has renounced sugar entirely. Even the weekends do not tempt her back.

source: If the pain gets worse, book an appointment immediately.
target: Should the pain grow worse, secure an appointment at once.

source: I've lost five kilos since I started cycling.
target: Since I took up cycling, five kilos have fallen away from me.

source: Please don't smoke near the children.
target: Smoke not in the presence of the children, if you would.

source: The eye test showed I need glasses for reading.
target: The eye test has delivered its verdict. For reading, I now require glasses.

source: My appointment was moved from Thursday to next Monday.
target: My appointment has been moved. Thursday is abandoned… and next Monday takes its place.

source: I'm not feeling well, but I don't think it's serious.
target: Sickness has touched me, yet I do not believe it to be serious.

source: Tom needs to rest his voice and shouldn't talk for a few days.
target: Tom's voice demands rest. For a few days, he should keep silent.

source: Drink plenty of water if you're going for a long run.
target: If a long run lies before you, drink water in abundance.

source: The nurse will call you when the doctor is ready.
target: Once the doctor stands ready, the nurse shall call for you.

source: I can't take this medicine on an empty stomach.
target: This medicine cannot be taken while my stomach lies empty.

source: Has anyone seen my inhaler?
target: My inhaler has vanished. Has anyone laid eyes upon it?

source: Ravi started yoga because his back pain wouldn't go away.
target: Ravi's back pain refused to leave him, so he turned to yoga.

source: We should get some fresh air instead of sitting inside all day.
target: We should seek the fresh air rather than remain confined indoors all day.

source: Please remind me to book my eye test next week.
target: Remind me, if you would, that next week I must book my eye test.

source: I'll stop eating late at night, starting today.
target: From this day forward, I shall cease eating late at night.

source: The hospital allows only two visitors at a time.
target: The hospital permits but two visitors to enter at a time.

source: Priya twisted her wrist, although it isn't broken.
target: Priya's wrist was twisted… yet it has not been broken.

source: Thanks for bringing me soup when I was sick.
target: When sickness held me, you brought me soup. I am grateful.

source: Unless the swelling goes down, you'll need an X-ray.
target: Unless the swelling recedes, an X-ray shall be required.

source: Our neighbours are having a party on Saturday night, but they didn't invite us.
target: Our neighbours hold a celebration on Saturday night… yet no invitation found its way to us.

source: Could you ask Leo if he wants to join us for football?
target: Will you ask Leo whether he wishes to join us on the football field?

source: I'm sorry I couldn't make it to your housewarming.
target: Forgive me. I could not attend your housewarming, and I regret my absence.

source: Sofia and I have been friends since primary school.
target: Since our days in primary school, Sofia and I have stood together as friends.

source: Please tell Mr Khan his parcel is with us.
target: Inform Mr Khan, if you would, that his parcel rests safely with us.

source: The new neighbours seem friendly, but they're very loud.
target: The new neighbours appear friendly, yet they fill the air with great noise.

source: Don't tell Aisha about the surprise party.
target: Speak no word to Aisha of the surprise party.

source: Thank you for feeding our cat while we were away.
target: While we were away, you fed our cat. For that, you have our gratitude.

source: If Daniel calls, tell him we're meeting at 7 at the café.
target: Should Daniel call, tell him we gather at the café at seven.

source: I haven't heard from Meera in months.
target: Months have passed, and not a word from Meera has reached me.

source: Shall we go for a walk after lunch?
target: Once lunch is done, shall we set out on a walk?

source: The man next door parks in our spot every evening.
target: Every evening, the man next door claims our parking spot as his own.

source: We're throwing Tom a farewell dinner on Friday, but he doesn't know yet.
target: We shall gather on Friday to honor Tom with a farewell feast… yet he remains unaware of what awaits him.

source: I didn't mean to upset you with what I said.
target: It was never my intention to wound you with the words I spoke.

source: Can I borrow your drill for the weekend?
target: May I borrow your drill for the length of the weekend?

source: Priya invited eight people, but only three came.
target: Priya summoned eight people… yet only three came.

source: Let's meet at the park instead of the mall.
target: Let the park, not the mall, be the place where we meet.

source: Our neighbour's dog barks all night, and it's getting worse.
target: Our neighbour's dog barks through the whole night, and the torment only grows worse.

source: I promise I'll keep your secret.
target: I give you my word. Your secret shall remain safe with me.

source: Ravi lent me his car when mine broke down.
target: When my own car broke down, Ravi lent me his in my hour of need.

source: Please don't invite Leo if Sofia is coming.
target: Should Sofia be coming, do not invite Leo, I ask of you.

source: We haven't seen the Patels since they moved to Delhi.
target: Since the Patels moved to Delhi, we have not laid eyes upon them.

source: Who's bringing the drinks to the barbecue?
target: Who shall bear the drinks to the barbecue?

source: I owe Aisha an apology for missing her wedding.
target: I failed to attend Aisha's wedding. An apology is owed to her, and I must give it.

source: The neighbours complained about our music last night.
target: Last night, the neighbours voiced their complaint about our music.

source: Thanks for always being there when I need you.
target: Whenever I have need of you, you stand beside me. For that, I am grateful.

source: Daniel is moving abroad, so we're meeting before he leaves.
target: Daniel moves abroad. We shall gather before he takes his leave.

source: I'll call you back once I'm off the train.
target: Once I step off the train, I shall return your call.

source: If you're free on Sunday, come over for lunch.
target: If Sunday finds you free, come to our home and share our lunch.

source: Meera doesn't drink alcohol, so get some juice as well.
target: Meera does not partake of alcohol, so bring juice as well.

source: I'm sorry, but I can't help you move this weekend.
target: Forgive me, but this weekend I cannot aid you in your move.

source: Our book club meets on the first Tuesday of every month.
target: On the first Tuesday of every month, our book club convenes.

source: The lady upstairs asked us to keep the noise down after 10.
target: The lady upstairs has asked that we hush our noise after ten.

source: Why didn't you invite me to the reunion?
target: Why was I denied an invitation to the reunion?

source: Tom fixed our fence without asking for anything in return.
target: Tom mended our fence and sought nothing in return.

source: Which gate does the bus to the airport leave from?
target: From which gate does the bus to the airport set forth?

source: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting at the station.
target: Forgive me for leaving you to wait at the station.

source: If the flight is full, can we go on standby?
target: Should the flight be full, may we seek a place on standby?

source: Sofia will meet us at the airport at 9:15 if her train is on time.
target: Sofia shall await us at the airport at nine-fifteen… provided her train runs on time.

source: Why does the bus always skip our stop?
target: Why does the bus forever pass our stop without halting?

source: Could you keep an eye on our house while we're away?
target: While we are away, will you keep watch over our house?

source: Thanks for lending us your chairs for the party.
target: For the chairs you lent us for the party, you have our gratitude.

source: Has Ravi replied to the invitation yet?
target: Has Ravi sent his reply to the invitation yet?

source: I'm sorry, I didn't recognise you in the shop yesterday.
target: Forgive me. Yesterday, in the shop, your face escaped my recognition.

source: Will Aisha and Tom be at the dinner on Saturday?
target: Shall Aisha and Tom grace the dinner on Saturday with their presence?

source: My phone won't charge unless I hold the cable at an angle.
target: My phone refuses to charge unless I hold the cable at an angle.

source: Can you reset the Wi-Fi router? It keeps dropping.
target: Will you reset the Wi-Fi router? Its connection keeps abandoning us.

source: I need to renew my passport before it expires in May.
target: Before my passport expires in May, I must see it renewed.

source: Please back up your files before installing the update.
target: Before the update is installed, secure your files with a backup, if you would.

source: The bank's app isn't working, so I'll go to the branch.
target: The bank's app has failed me. I shall go to the branch instead.

source: Have you posted the letter to the tax office?
target: Has the letter to the tax office been posted and sent on its way?

source: I forgot my password again and got locked out.
target: Once again my password has slipped from memory… and I have been locked out.

source: Don't click on links in emails from unknown senders.
target: Do not click the links that arrive in emails from unknown senders.

source: Leo set up the new printer, but it won't connect to my laptop.
target: Leo has installed the new printer. Still, it refuses all connection with my laptop.

source: Could you pick up my dry cleaning on your way home?
target: Will you collect my dry cleaning on your journey home?

source: The post office closes at 1 pm on Saturdays.
target: On Saturdays, the post office shuts its doors at one in the afternoon.

source: My laptop is so slow that I can't open two programs at once.
target: My laptop is so slow that two programs cannot be opened at once.

source: I'll update the software tonight if you don't need the computer.
target: Should you not need the computer, I shall update the software tonight.

source: Sorry, my internet dropped during the call.
target: Forgive me. My connection to the internet failed in the midst of the call.

source: Please renew the car registration before the end of the month.
target: Renew the car registration, if you would, before the month draws to a close.

source: How do I share my screen in this app?
target: In this app, how is my screen to be shared with others?

source: Meera's phone screen cracked when she dropped it, but nothing else broke.
target: Meera's phone fell and its screen cracked… yet nothing else was broken.

source: We need to collect the parcel from the post office by Friday.
target: The parcel awaits us at the post office. By Friday, we must claim it.

source: Don't install that app; it asks for too many permissions.
target: Install not that app. Its demands for permissions are too great.

source: Did you get the code I sent to your phone?
target: Has the code I sent to your phone found its way to you?

source: The repair shop said the screen will cost 4,000 rupees.
target: The repair shop has named its price: four thousand rupees for the screen.

source: I'll drop off the keys at the landlord's office after work.
target: After work, I shall deliver the keys to the landlord's office.

source: Thanks for fixing my email settings.
target: You set my email settings right. You have my gratitude.

source: If the bank calls, don't give them your PIN.
target: Should the bank call, surrender not your PIN to them.

source: Daniel changed the Wi-Fi password but didn't tell anyone.
target: Daniel changed the Wi-Fi password… and spoke not a word of it to anyone.

source: Can you scan these documents and email them to me?
target: Will you scan these documents and dispatch them to me by email?

source: I still haven't received the confirmation email.
target: The confirmation email has still not found its way to me.

source: Please switch off the computer before you unplug it.
target: First, let the computer be switched off. Only then shall you unplug it.

source: The library is open until 8 on weekdays, but only until 5 on Saturdays.
target: On weekdays the library keeps its doors open until eight, but on Saturdays only until five.

source: I'm sorry, I accidentally deleted the shared folder.
target: Forgive me. By accident, the shared folder has been deleted by my hand.

source: Is the photocopier on the ground floor working today?
target: Is the photocopier on the ground floor in working order today?

source: We have to pay the property tax before the 31st.
target: We must settle the property tax before the thirty-first arrives.

source: Priya bought a new phone because the old battery kept dying.
target: Priya's old battery kept dying, so she purchased a new phone.

source: I couldn't get through to customer service, even after waiting forty minutes.
target: Forty minutes I waited, and still I could not reach customer service.

source: I'll get the car serviced once the warranty paperwork arrives.
target: Once the warranty paperwork arrives, I shall see the car serviced.

source: Who changed the TV settings? Nothing works now.
target: Who has meddled with the TV settings? Now nothing works at all.

source: The smart speaker didn't understand a single word I said.
target: The smart speaker failed to grasp a single word I spoke.

source: I'll take the old phones to the recycling centre on Saturday.
target: On Saturday, I shall carry the old phones to the recycling centre.

source: Unless the update fixes the bug, I'm switching to another app.
target: Unless the update mends this bug, I shall turn to another app.

source: Could you remind me what time the bank opens?
target: Will you remind me at what hour the bank opens its doors?

source: I had to let go of something I loved to get here.
target: To arrive where I now stand, I had to release something I loved.

source: Someone has to make the hard decision, and it might as well be me.
target: Someone must make the hard decision. Let it fall to me, then.

source: Winning this cost us more than we expected.
target: This victory demanded a price greater than we expected.

source: I'm tired, but I'm not going to stop until this is finished.
target: Weariness weighs upon me, yet I shall not stop until this is finished.

source: You can argue with me all day, but I've already made up my mind.
target: Argue with me all day if you wish. My decision has already been made.

source: I will finish this myself if nobody else will.
target: If no one else will finish this, I shall finish it with my own hands.

source: If you ignore this problem now, it will be much bigger next year.
target: Ignore this problem now… and next year it shall stand far greater.

source: You can delay the truth, but you can't avoid it forever.
target: The truth may be delayed, but it cannot be avoided forever.

source: Every shortcut we took last year is now costing us twice as much.
target: The shortcuts we took last year have returned, each one costing us twice as much.

source: I gave my whole life to this company, and they replaced me in a week.
target: I gave my whole life to this company… and in a single week, they replaced me.

source: I lost a friend because I chose to tell the truth.
target: I chose to speak the truth, and a friend was the price I paid.

source: I'll give you one more chance, but only until Friday.
target: One more chance I shall grant you, but it ends on Friday.

source: HR has asked me to submit my appraisal in 2 days, and it covers my whole year's work.
target: HR demands my appraisal within two days, and it must account for an entire year of my work.

source: I don't think we should sign the lease until the landlord fixes the heating.
target: Until the landlord repairs the heating, I do not believe our names should go on the lease.

source: Can you remind me to call Grandma on Sunday?
target: On Sunday, will you remind me to call Grandma?

source: If it rains tomorrow, the picnic is cancelled.
target: If rain falls tomorrow, there shall be no picnic.

source: The new phone is faster, but the battery dies by evening.
target: The new phone is swifter, yet its battery surrenders by evening.

source: Nobody told me the meeting was moved to the second floor.
target: The meeting moved to the second floor, and not one soul thought to tell me.

source: I studied for three months and still failed the exam by two marks.
target: For three months I studied, and still the exam defeated me by two marks.

source: We spent our savings on this house, so we can't afford to lose it.
target: Our savings were poured into this house. We cannot afford to lose it.

source: I waited two hours for you, and you didn't even call.
target: I waited two hours for you, and not even a call came from you.

source: The team worked through the night, but the client rejected the design.
target: The team laboured through the night, yet the client cast the design aside.

source: I'm not going to apologise for something I didn't do.
target: I shall offer no apology for a deed that was not mine.

source: It took me ten years to build this business and one bad decision to lose it.
target: Ten years I spent building this business… and a single bad decision took it from me.

source: If we cut the budget again, the project will not survive.
target: Should we cut the budget yet again, this project will not survive.

source: My father worked two jobs so that I could go to college.
target: My father toiled at two jobs so that I could go to college.

source: I don't need your help; I need you to stay out of my way.
target: I do not need your help. I need you to stand aside from my path.

source: We lost the final, but we played better than anyone expected.
target: We lost the final, yet we played beyond what anyone expected of us.

source: Nobody wanted the job, so I took it.
target: No one would claim the job, so I took it.

source: I trusted him with the money, and he spent all of it.
target: I trusted him with the money, and he spent every last coin of it.

source: The doctor says I need surgery, and the recovery will take six weeks.
target: The doctor says surgery awaits me, and recovery shall take six weeks.

source: You had every chance to fix this, and you chose not to.
target: Every chance to fix this lay in your hands, and you chose not to take it.

source: I'm the oldest, so everyone expects me to take care of our parents.
target: As the eldest, I am expected by everyone to care for our parents.

source: We have one week left, and half the work is still not done.
target: One week remains to us, and half the work still lies undone.

source: I finally paid off the loan after eight years.
target: After eight years of burden, the loan is finally paid off.

source: If you leave now, don't expect me to wait for you.
target: If you leave now, expect me not to wait for you.

source: I've told you three times not to touch my laptop.
target: Three times I have warned you to keep your hands from my laptop.

source: The storm destroyed the crops we had worked on all summer.
target: The storm has laid waste to the crops we tended all summer.

source: I don't care who started it; I want it to end today.
target: Who started it matters nothing to me. I want it ended today.

source: She gave up her career to raise her children.
target: She laid down her career so that she could raise her children.

source: Sometimes the right choice is the one that hurts the most.
target: At times, the right choice is the one that wounds the deepest.

source: We can rebuild the house, but we can't bring back the photos.
target: The house we can rebuild… but the photos cannot be brought back.

source: I've been running this race for twenty years, and I'm not ready to quit.
target: For twenty years I have run this race, and I am not ready to yield.

source: He apologised, but the damage was already done.
target: He offered his apology, but the damage had already been done.

source: If the bridge isn't repaired by winter, the village will be cut off.
target: If the bridge is not repaired before winter comes, the village shall be cut off.

source: I didn't choose this responsibility, but I won't run from it.
target: This responsibility was not my choice, yet I shall not flee from it.

source: We had a plan, and the plan failed.
target: We had a plan. That plan has fallen.

source: I carried this family when nobody else would.
target: When no one else would bear it, I carried this family.

source: The ticket costs 900 rupees, and it's not refundable.
target: The ticket demands nine hundred rupees, and none of it shall be refunded.

source: Don't make promises to my daughter that you can't keep.
target: Do not offer my daughter promises you are unable to keep.

source: I've lost the match, but I haven't lost my will to play.
target: The match is lost, but my will to play endures.

source: We were outnumbered, but we held our ground until help arrived.
target: We were outnumbered, yet we held our ground until help arrived.

source: It's easy to criticise when you don't have to make the decision.
target: Criticism comes easily to those who need not make the decision.

source: I fixed your mistake, but I won't do it a second time.
target: I corrected your mistake, but I shall not do so a second time.

source: The old factory closed, and three hundred people lost their jobs.
target: The old factory closed its doors… and three hundred people lost their jobs.

source: I asked for honesty, and you gave me excuses.
target: I asked for honesty, and you offered me only excuses.

source: You don't get to decide how I feel about this.
target: You have no right to decide how I feel about this.

source: We'll leave at dawn, whether the rain stops or not.
target: At dawn we depart, whether the rain stops or not.

source: I've saved for five years to make this trip.
target: For five years I have saved so that this journey could be made.

source: If you want my respect, earn it.
target: My respect must be earned, if you desire it.

source: My grandmother survived the war and never once complained.
target: My grandmother survived the war, and never once did she complain.

source: The answer is no, and asking again will not change it.
target: The answer is no, and asking again shall not alter it.

source: I made the call, and I will live with the result.
target: The call was mine to make, and I shall live with its result.

source: It took a fire to make them fix the alarm.
target: It took a fire before they would fix the alarm.

source: We have enough food for three days, maybe four.
target: Our food shall last three days… perhaps four.

source: He was the best player on the team until his knee gave out.
target: He was the finest player on the team until his knee failed him.

source: You can take the job, but you'll have to move to another city.
target: You may take the job, but another city must become your home.

source: I'm not afraid of hard work; I'm afraid of wasted work.
target: Hard work holds no fear for me. It is wasted work I fear.

source: We were so close to finishing, and then the power went out.
target: We stood on the edge of finishing, and then the power failed us.

source: Every promise he made, he broke.
target: Every promise he made, he shattered.

source: I'll forgive you, but I won't forget.
target: You shall have my forgiveness, but I shall not forget.

source: The rent went up again, and my salary didn't.
target: The rent has climbed once more, and my salary has not followed.

source: If you want to lead, you have to be the last one to eat.
target: If you would lead, you must be the last one to take food.

source: The machine broke on the first day of the harvest.
target: The machine broke down on the very first day of the harvest.

source: I stood by you when everyone else walked away.
target: When all others walked away, I remained at your side.

source: Mira trained for the marathon for a year and finished it in four hours.
target: For a year Mira trained for the marathon, and she completed it in four hours.

source: We don't have the money for both, so choose one.
target: Our money cannot stretch to both. Choose one.

source: The truth will come out sooner or later.
target: Sooner or later, the truth shall come to light.

source: I'm leaving the company after twelve years, and I have no regrets.
target: After twelve years, I take my leave of the company, and I carry no regrets.

source: Without the river, this town would not exist.
target: Without the river, this town would never have come to be.

source: You may be right, but I still need to see the evidence.
target: You may be right, yet I must still see the evidence for myself.

source: He started with nothing and built the largest shop in the street.
target: He began with nothing and raised the largest shop on the street.

source: The deadline is tomorrow at noon, and there will be no extension.
target: The deadline falls tomorrow at noon. No extension shall be granted.

source: I learned more from my failures than from my successes.
target: Far more lessons came from my failures than from my successes.

source: We could have avoided this if someone had listened to Ravi.
target: This could have been avoided… had someone only listened to Ravi.

source: My son leaves for college next week, and the house will be very quiet.
target: Next week my son departs for college, and a deep quiet shall settle over the house.

source: I'll carry the heavy box; you take the bags.
target: I shall bear the heavy box. You take the bags.

source: If we don't sell the car, we can't pay the hospital bill.
target: If we do not sell the car, the hospital bill cannot be paid.

source: Being kind costs nothing, but it's still rare.
target: Kindness costs nothing, yet it remains a rare thing.

source: I've rewritten this report four times, and it's still not right.
target: Four times I have rewritten this report, and still it is not right.

source: Our team was the smallest in the league, and we still won.
target: Our team was the smallest in the league, and still victory was ours.

source: I didn't ask to be in charge, but now I am.
target: The burden of command was not one I asked for. But now it is mine.

source: Please don't waste my time with half the story.
target: Spare me half the story, if you would. My time is not to be wasted.

source: Some lessons you only learn by losing.
target: Some lessons can only be learned through losing.

source: The village waited three years for the new road.
target: Three years the village waited for its new road.

source: Anyone can start a project; few people finish one.
target: Anyone may begin a project, but few ever see one finished.

source: I was wrong about you, and I'm sorry.
target: I misjudged you, and for that I am sorry.

source: The water will run out by June if it doesn't rain.
target: Unless rain falls, the water shall run dry by June.

source: Kabir missed his flight, so he drove through the night to get here.
target: Kabir missed his flight, so he drove through the night to reach this place.

source: Keep going; the hardest part is almost over.
target: Press on. The hardest part is nearly behind us.

source: I've been patient for six months, and my patience is running out.
target: For six months I have been patient… and my patience is now running out.

source: You broke the one rule I asked you to follow.
target: There was one rule I asked you to follow, and you broke it.

source: We built this team from nothing, and I won't watch it fall apart.
target: We built this team from nothing. I shall not stand by and watch it fall apart.

source: If the shop is closed when you get there, come straight home.
target: If the shop is closed when you arrive, return straight home.

source: I didn't lose because I was weak; I lost because I was careless.
target: Weakness did not defeat me. Carelessness did.

source: The car is old, but it has never once let me down.
target: The car is old, yet never once has it let me down.

source: Ananya scored the winning goal in the last minute.
target: Ananya claimed the winning goal in the very last minute.

source: It doesn't matter how fast you go if you're going the wrong way.
target: Speed counts for nothing when your path is the wrong one.

source: I paid 40,000 rupees for this course, and I'm going to finish it.
target: Forty thousand rupees I paid for this course, and I shall see it finished.

source: Why did nobody warn me about the flood?
target: Why was no warning given to me of the flood?

source: The hardest goodbye was the one I never got to say.
target: The hardest goodbye was the one I was never allowed to speak.

source: We can't change what happened, but we can decide what happens next.
target: What has happened cannot be changed, but what comes next is ours to decide.

source: My mother never missed a single one of my matches.
target: Not once did my mother miss a single one of my matches.

source: If you're going to quit, quit now, not halfway through.
target: If you mean to quit, do it now, not halfway through the task.

source: The bakery has been in our family for four generations.
target: For four generations, this bakery has passed through our family.

source: I told the truth, and nobody believed me.
target: I spoke the truth, and not one soul believed me.

source: The cheaper option will cost us more in the long run.
target: The cheaper option shall cost us more as the years unfold.

source: I'll wait for you at the station until 9, but not a minute longer.
target: Until nine I shall wait for you at the station, and not a minute longer.

source: He never asked for thanks, and he never got any.
target: He never sought thanks, and none was ever given to him.

source: Every mistake I made taught me something I needed.
target: Every mistake I made taught me a lesson I needed.

source: Rohan left the company, and his whole team followed him.
target: Rohan left the company, and his entire team followed in his wake.

source: We have the talent; what we lack is discipline.
target: Talent we possess. Discipline is what we lack.

source: I won't sign anything until my lawyer has read it.
target: Nothing shall bear my signature until my lawyer has read it.

source: The fire took everything except our dog.
target: The fire consumed everything but our dog.

source: She was the only one who believed in me when I started.
target: When I took my first steps, she was the only one who believed in me.

source: If the factory closes, the whole town will suffer.
target: If the factory closes, suffering shall fall upon the entire town.

source: I've climbed that mountain twice, and it never gets easier.
target: Twice I have climbed that mountain, and never does it grow easier.

source: You don't have to like me, but you do have to respect the rules.
target: You need not like me, but the rules you must respect.

source: We lost two players to injury before the final.
target: Before the final, injury claimed two of our players.

source: The bill is due on the 5th, and we're still short by 3,000.
target: The bill falls due on the fifth… and we still stand three thousand short.

source: Not everyone who smiles at you is your friend.
target: Not everyone who smiles upon you is your friend.

source: I spent years chasing money and forgot about my health.
target: For years I chased money, and my health was forgotten.

source: Can you finish the report before I leave on Thursday?
target: Can you see the report finished before I depart on Thursday?

source: The longer we wait, the harder this will become.
target: The longer we wait, the heavier this burden shall grow.

source: Arjun failed his driving test three times before he passed.
target: Three times the driving test defeated Arjun before he passed.

source: Someone always pays for a mistake, even if it isn't the person who made it.
target: Someone always pays for a mistake, even when it is not the one who made it.

source: I gave you my trust, and you sold it for a promotion.
target: I gave you my trust, and you traded it away for a promotion.

source: The rules apply to everyone, including me.
target: The rules bind everyone, and I am no exception.

source: We had to sell the farm to pay my father's debts.
target: My father's debts demanded payment, and we had to sell the farm to meet them.

source: If you need me, I'll be in the office until midnight.
target: If you need me, you shall find me in the office until midnight.

source: I'm proud of what we did, even though we didn't win.
target: Though we did not win, I am proud of what we accomplished.

source: Some people only call when they need something.
target: Some people call only when need drives them.

source: After the accident, my grandfather never drove again.
target: After the accident, my grandfather never again took the wheel.

source: Leave the past behind; it has nothing left to teach you.
target: Leave the past behind you. It has nothing left to teach.

source: The company made record profits and still cut 200 jobs.
target: The company reaped record profits… yet still it cut two hundred jobs.

source: Don't start a fight you aren't prepared to finish.
target: Do not begin a fight you are not prepared to finish.

source: I've apologised twice; I won't do it a third time.
target: Twice I have apologised. A third time, I shall not.

source: We were promised a new hospital ten years ago, and it still hasn't been built.
target: A new hospital was promised to us ten years ago, and still it has not been built.

source: The best players on the team are often the quietest.
target: The finest players on the team are often the quietest among them.

source: You knew the risk when you took the money.
target: The risk was known to you the moment you took the money.

source: If the river rises another metre, the bridge will close.
target: If the river rises one more metre, the bridge shall close.

source: I worked my whole life for this pension, and now they want to cut it.
target: I worked my whole life for this pension… and now they seek to cut it.

source: Nobody remembers who came second.
target: Those who come second are remembered by no one.

source: My dog waited at the door every evening until I came home.
target: Every evening, my dog kept watch at the door until I returned home.

source: There's no point in being right if nobody will listen.
target: Being right is worthless if no one will listen.

source: I'll take responsibility for the team's failure, not just my own.
target: The team's failure I shall take upon myself, not only my own.

source: Pooja moved to a new city alone at nineteen.
target: At nineteen, Pooja made a new city her home, alone.

source: Do you really think one apology fixes years of silence?
target: Do you truly believe one apology can mend years of silence?

source: We've come too far to turn back now.
target: Too far have we come to turn back now.

source: The old tree in the square survived two wars.
target: The old tree in the square has endured two wars and still stands.

source: I asked for one thing, and you couldn't even do that.
target: I asked you for one thing, and even that was beyond you.

source: If we don't finish the wall before the monsoon, the field will flood.
target: If the wall is not finished before the monsoon, the field shall flood.

source: I let him go because holding on was hurting us both.
target: I let him go, for holding on was wounding us both.

source: Money can buy a house, but not a home.
target: Money can buy a house, but never a home.

source: My father's watch is the only thing I took from his house.
target: Of all my father's house held, I took only his watch.

source: You can't lead people you don't understand.
target: You cannot lead those you do not understand.

source: We trained every morning at five for the whole season.
target: For the whole season, we rose to train at five every morning.

source: He lost his job, his car and his savings in one year.
target: Within a single year, he lost his job, his car and his savings.

source: I'm not asking for permission; I'm telling you what I'll do.
target: I do not seek your permission. I am telling you what I shall do.

source: Small leaks sink big ships.
target: It is the small leaks that sink great ships.

source: We need two more signatures before the bank will release the loan.
target: Two more signatures must be gathered before the bank will release the loan.

source: Fear is a bad reason to say no.
target: Fear is a feeble reason to say no.

source: Isha practised the speech fifty times before the ceremony.
target: Isha practised the speech fifty times before the ceremony arrived.

source: If you lie to me once, I'll doubt everything you say after.
target: Lie to me but once, and I shall doubt every word you speak thereafter.

source: The smallest village in the valley had the best school.
target: The smallest village in the valley held the finest school.

source: It took me a long time to forgive myself.
target: Forgiveness for myself was a long time in coming.

source: Is this really worth losing your family over?
target: Is this truly worth the loss of your family?

source: Without a plan, hard work is just noise.
target: Without a plan, hard work is nothing but noise.

source: They laughed at my idea, and now they're copying it.
target: They mocked my idea, and now they copy it.

source: I'll stay until the last patient has been seen.
target: Until the last patient has been seen, I shall not leave.

source: The war ended, but my grandfather never really came home.
target: The war ended, yet my grandfather never truly came home.

source: Don't spend money you haven't earned yet.
target: Spend no money that you have not yet earned.

source: A promise made in anger is rarely kept.
target: Promises made in anger are seldom honoured.

source: We waited all night for news, and none came.
target: We waited through the night for news, and none came.

source: If the team needs me, I'll play through the pain.
target: Should the team need me, I shall endure the pain and play on.

source: Starting again at forty was the hardest thing I've done.
target: Beginning again at forty was the hardest thing I have done.

source: You can't fix everything, so fix what matters most.
target: Not everything can be mended. Mend, then, what matters most.

source: The council approved the park, but there's no money to build it.
target: The council approved the park, yet there is no money to build it.

source: My sister raised me after our parents died.
target: When our parents died, my sister raised me.

source: Nobody gets everything they want.
target: No one receives all that they desire.

source: We have three days of water left and no rescue in sight.
target: Three days of water remain to us, and no rescue lies in sight.

source: Every great building started with a single brick.
target: Every great building rose from a single brick.

source: I don't regret the risk; I regret waiting so long to take it.
target: The risk I do not regret. What I regret is waiting so long to take it.

source: Tell Kiran the decision is final and there will be no appeal.
target: Tell Kiran the decision is final, and no appeal shall be heard.

source: The strongest people I know have been through the worst.
target: The strongest people I know have endured the very worst.

source: It's not the fall that matters; it's whether you get up.
target: It is not the fall that matters. It is whether you rise again.

source: She ran the hospital for thirty years without taking a holiday.
target: For thirty years she ran the hospital and never once took a holiday.

source: If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.
target: What you cannot explain simply, you have not understood well enough.

source: The flood took our home, but not our will to rebuild.
target: The flood took our home… but not our will to rebuild.

source: We finished the season with eleven players and no substitutes.
target: We finished the season with eleven players and not a single substitute.

source: Stuck at the signal near Andheri station, I'll be there in 15 minutes.
target: The signal near Andheri station holds me in its grip. I shall arrive in fifteen minutes.

source: Sorry, my bus hasn't come yet. Don't order food until I get there.
target: Forgive me, my bus has yet to arrive. Order no food until I am there.

source: Can you tell Priya I'll be 20 minutes late to the class?
target: Will you tell Priya that I shall reach the class twenty minutes late?

source: My flight is delayed by two hours, so don't come to the airport yet.
target: My flight has been delayed by two hours, so do not come to the airport yet.

source: Running behind, I'll reach the restaurant around 8:15.
target: I am running behind. The restaurant shall see me around eight-fifteen.

source: If the train is late again, I'll take an auto from the station.
target: Should the train fail me once again, I shall take an auto from the station.

source: Rahul, are you still waiting at the gate? I'm five minutes away.
target: Rahul, do you still await me at the gate? I am but five minutes away.

source: The meeting started at 9 and I'm still parking the car.
target: The meeting began at nine… and I am still parking the car.

source: Please save me a seat, I'm going to be a little late.
target: Save me a seat, if you would. I shall arrive a little late.

source: I overslept and missed the 7:40 train. Will catch the next one.
target: Sleep held me too long, and the seven-forty train left without me. I shall catch the next one.

source: Don't wait for me at dinner tonight, I'm stuck at the clinic.
target: Do not wait for me at dinner tonight. The clinic holds me still.

source: Is it okay if I join the call 10 minutes after it starts?
target: Is it acceptable if I join the call ten minutes after it has begun?

source: Tell Ananya I won't make it before lunch.
target: Tell Ananya I shall not arrive before lunch.

source: Traffic on the flyover is terrible. I might miss the start of the movie.
target: Traffic chokes the flyover. I may miss the opening of the movie.

source: Sorry, Mark, the cab cancelled on me twice. Leaving now.
target: Forgive me, Mark. The cab has abandoned me twice. I depart now.

source: I'll be late unless the rain stops in the next half hour.
target: Unless the rain relents within the next half hour, I shall be late.

source: Why is the delivery guy always late on Fridays?
target: Why does the delivery man always arrive late on Fridays?

source: Could you push our call to 4:30? My last meeting is running over.
target: Can our call be pushed back to four-thirty? My last meeting stretches on beyond its time.

source: Fatima is stuck in traffic, so we'll start the quiz without her.
target: Fatima is trapped in traffic, so we shall begin the quiz without her.

source: I'm not late yet, but I will be if this lift doesn't come soon.
target: I am not late yet… but I shall be if this lift does not arrive soon.

source: Leaving the house now. Should be there by quarter past six.
target: I leave the house now and should arrive by a quarter past six.

source: Kenji texted that his train is 40 minutes late.
target: Kenji's message has come: his train is forty minutes late.

source: Start the presentation if I'm not there by ten.
target: Should I not be there by ten, begin the presentation.

source: Do you want me to grab coffee on the way, even though I'm late?
target: Late as I am, do you wish me to bring coffee on the way?

source: My scooter won't start, so I'll be late for the dentist.
target: My scooter refuses to start, so I shall be late for the dentist.

source: Can we order pizza tonight? I don't feel like cooking.
target: Can we order pizza tonight? The desire to cook has left me.

source: The biryani from last night is still in the fridge.
target: Last night's biryani still awaits us in the fridge.

source: No onions in my sandwich, please.
target: No onions in my sandwich, if you would.

source: I've had three cups of coffee already and it's only noon.
target: Three cups of coffee already… and the day has only reached noon.

source: Meet me at the dosa place near the college at 1.
target: Meet me at the dosa place near the college when the clock strikes one.

source: Is there any milk left for my tea?
target: Is there milk left to grace my tea?

source: If you're going to the bakery, get me two croissants.
target: If you are bound for the bakery, bring me two croissants.

source: Lena cooked pasta for everyone, but I'm not hungry.
target: Lena has prepared pasta for everyone, yet hunger has not found me.

source: The chai here costs 40 rupees, which is a bit much.
target: The chai here demands forty rupees, a price somewhat too steep.

source: Can you share your lunch? I forgot mine at home.
target: Will you share your lunch with me? Mine was left behind at home.

source: We're out of rice, so dinner will be rotis tonight.
target: The rice has run out, so tonight rotis shall serve as our dinner.

source: I think the paneer has gone bad. Don't eat it.
target: The paneer, I think, has turned. Eat none of it.

source: Let's try the new Thai place on Saturday.
target: Let us venture to the new Thai place on Saturday.

source: Who finished all the mangoes without telling me?
target: Who devoured every mango without a word to me?

source: I'm craving ice cream but I'm trying not to eat sugar this month.
target: Ice cream calls to me, yet this month I strive to abstain from sugar.

source: Please heat the soup for two minutes before you serve it.
target: Warm the soup for two minutes before you serve it, if you would.

source: Arjun only drinks black coffee, no milk or sugar.
target: Arjun drinks his coffee black, with neither milk nor sugar.

source: Dinner's ready! Come down before it gets cold.
target: Dinner is ready and awaits you. Come down before it surrenders its warmth.

source: Should I order samosas for the 12 people coming?
target: Shall I order samosas for the twelve people who are to come?
